text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower and I have a track reserved for afternoon practice, but there's suddenly an unforeseen downpour.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look, Big Brother! It's raining cats and dogs! Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look, Big Sister! It's raining cats and dogs! Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You said you wanted me to train on a soft track, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You said you wanted me to train on a soft track, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So I thought if I wished for sunny weather… it would probably rain instead!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I hung up tons of sunshine dolls in my room and wished for it to be sunny every day!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And now, look at the weather! At this rate, the track will be soft by the afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While it's hard to say if this is really something to celebrate, Rice's happiness makes it easy to overlook.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the afternoon…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no way…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the rain from this morning has dried up! The track is firm again!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I guess I should have known better than to expect things to work out my way…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her enthusiasm is plummeting like a rock! At this rate…
choice_data_list: Let's take advantage of the sunshine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her enthusiasm is plummeting like a rock! At this rate…
choice_data_list: Let's take advantage of the sunshine.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Now?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What a big voice you have, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What a big voice you have, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-right!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um… R-raaain! FAAALL!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really? I-I never shout like this. It's honestly a little embarrassing…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but it's kinda fun too…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We continue to do voice training on the empty track by screaming at the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's exhausting, but at least it keeps Rice Shower's spirits high.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Take advantage of the sunshine? What do you mean?
choice_data_list: Let's practice on the track while it's firm!
Let's practice on the track while it's firm!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-is it really okay to change our plans?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You're right, though… The track does look perfect.
choice_data_list: That's it! Let's look on the bright side.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look on… the bright side…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right. The sunshine feels so good!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want to start training right now!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want to start training right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower's motivation rises once more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She makes good use of the firm track for the rest of the day's training.
